# Test basic sc commands

# Test validate
sc validate chart.json
stdout 'VALID'

# Test info
sc info chart.json
stdout 'States:'
stdout 'Transitions:'
stdout 'Events:'

# Test states - outputs one state per line
sc states chart.json
stdout '__root__'
stdout 'Red'
stdout 'Green'

# Test leaf-only states
sc states -leaf chart.json
stdout 'Red'
stdout 'Green'
stdout 'Yellow'
! stdout '__root__'
! stdout 'Normal'

# Test events
sc events chart.json
stdout 'TIMER_EXPIRED'
stdout 'EMERGENCY'

-- chart.json --
{
  "root_state": {
    "label": "__root__",
    "type": 2,
    "children": [
      {
        "label": "Normal",
        "type": 2,
        "children": [
          {"label": "Red", "type": 1, "is_initial": true},
          {"label": "Green", "type": 1},
          {"label": "Yellow", "type": 1}
        ],
        "is_initial": true
      },
      {
        "label": "Emergency",
        "type": 1
      }
    ]
  },
  "transitions": [
    {"label": "ToGreen", "from": ["Red"], "to": ["Green"], "event": "TIMER_EXPIRED"},
    {"label": "ToYellow", "from": ["Green"], "to": ["Yellow"], "event": "TIMER_EXPIRED"},
    {"label": "ToRed", "from": ["Yellow"], "to": ["Red"], "event": "TIMER_EXPIRED"},
    {"label": "Panic", "from": ["Normal"], "to": ["Emergency"], "event": "EMERGENCY"}
  ],
  "events": [
    {"label": "TIMER_EXPIRED"},
    {"label": "EMERGENCY"}
  ]
}
